items.title: Australia says it won’t buy Russian fuel despite Trump’s diesel agreement
items.summary: Australia has no need to buy fuel from Russia and said that purchases from there would remain barred so that the country did not benefit from the invasion of Ukraine. “We don’t need or want Russian fuel in Australia,” Chris Bowen, Australia’s minister for climate change and energy, said on Saturday at a press conference in western Sydney. “We do not want Vladimir Putin to benefit from this war in the Middle East. What the United States does is a matter for them, but we won’t be changing our...

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚表示尽管有特朗普的柴油协议，仍不会购买俄罗斯燃料
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚能源部长克里斯·鲍文表示，澳大利亚不需要也不想要俄罗斯燃料，并将继续禁止相关进口。他强调，澳大利亚不会因美国政策的变动而改变对俄制裁立场。
items.whyImportant: 此举表明澳大利亚在对俄制裁问题上保持独立立场，不愿因国际贸易协议而削弱对俄压力。

items.title: How the trial of two murdered Australian surfers ended in a guilty verdict
items.summary: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".

items.titleZh: 两名澳大利亚冲浪者遇害案如何以有罪判决告终
items.summaryZh: 两年前在墨西哥遇害的两名澳大利亚冲浪者及其美国朋友的家属对此表示，追究责任至关重要。该案的审判最终以被告被判有罪而结束。
items.whyImportant: 此判决为受害者家属提供了法律层面的正义，并引起了国际社会对墨西哥安全状况的关注。

items.title: Congressional Bills S. 195 Signed into Law
items.summary: On Friday, October 9, 2026, the President signed into law: S. 195, the “American Music Tourism Act of 2025,” which requires the Department of Commerce to promote domestic and international travel and tourism to locations and events in the United States that are important to music tourism. The post Congressional Bills S. 195 Signed into Law appeared first on The White House.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 美国国会S. 195法案签署成为法律
items.summaryZh: 美国总统于2026年10月9日签署了《2025年美国音乐旅游法案》。该法案要求商务部推广美国境内与音乐旅游相关的地点和活动，以促进国内外旅游业发展。
items.whyImportant: 该法案旨在通过挖掘音乐文化资源，进一步推动美国旅游业的经济增长。

items.title: ‘Serious blow’: Guterres condemns new US sanctions on International Criminal Court
items.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) as an institution, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio vowing on Friday to “dismantle the ICC, brick by brick” unless it ends what Washington regards as a “threat” to its citizens.

items.titleZh: “严重打击”：古特雷斯谴责美国对国际刑事法院实施新制裁
items.summaryZh: 美国政府对国际刑事法院实施了制裁，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥誓言要“一块砖一块砖地拆除”该机构。联合国秘书长古特雷斯对此表示谴责。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国与国际司法机构之间的对抗升级，引发了关于国际法权威性的广泛争议。

items.title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
items.summary: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 分析：特朗普与俄罗斯达成的惊人协议凸显了抑制燃油价格的巨大压力
items.summaryZh: 美国总统希望在下个月的中期选举前缓解其政党的选情压力。BBC北美记者分析称，此举反映了政府在应对能源价格问题上的紧迫感。
items.whyImportant: 该协议显示了美国政府为应对国内通胀和选举压力，正在调整其能源外交政策。

items.title: Livestreaming US execution would breach prohibition of torture, UN rights office warns
items.summary: The UN human rights office (OHCHR) on Friday warned that livestreaming a planned execution by firing squad in the United States would amount to a public execution and breach the absolute prohibition on torture.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 联合国人权办警告：直播美国死刑执行过程将违反禁止酷刑规定
items.summaryZh: 联合国人权事务高级专员办事处警告称，直播美国计划中的行刑队处决将构成公开处决。此举被认为违反了国际法中关于禁止酷刑的绝对禁令。
items.whyImportant: 该警告强调了国际社会对死刑执行方式及其人权影响的严格审查标准。

items.title: China’s Pacific ties not part of ‘geopolitical rivalry’, Wang Yi tells island leaders
items.summary: China’s cooperation with the Pacific islands is not part of a geopolitical competition, top diplomat Wang Yi told a delegation of politicians from the region on Friday. The comments come as Beijing and Washington vie for influence in the South Pacific. “China’s engagement with Pacific island countries is a form of South-South cooperation based on mutual assistance and support,” Wang said, according to a statement from the Communist Party’s International Department. “This cooperation does not...

items.titleZh: 王毅向太平洋岛国领导人表示：中国与太平洋关系不属于“地缘政治竞争”
items.summaryZh: 中国外交部长王毅向太平洋岛国代表团表示，中国与该地区的合作属于南南合作，旨在互助支持。他强调此举并非为了参与地缘政治竞争。
items.whyImportant: 此表态旨在回应外界对中国在南太平洋地区影响力扩张的关切，并重申其外交政策立场。

items.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
items.summary: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade. Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’? Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible? And has there been a cover-up? Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced. His body was soaked with sweat and he felt like his eyes were spinning in their sockets. He manoeuvred his way out of bed, hoping to make it to the bathroom to vomit, but found his sense of balance had deserted him. Eventually, he fell back into a fitful, shallow sleep. The next day, arriving at the work meeting he had travelled for, the officer found he could not remember the names of colleagues in the room, people he knew well. As the meeting got under way, he could barely follow the discussion. Initially, he chalked it up to a terrible – if rather odd – case of food poisoning. But over subsequent weeks, worrying symptoms persisted: brain fog, loss of balance and increasingly harsh tinnitus. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “像钻头钻进眼睛”：为何关于“哈瓦那综合征”的谜团挥之不去
items.summaryZh: 过去十年中，数十名中情局官员遭受了严重的虚弱症状困扰。目前尚不清楚这究竟是“群体性癔症”还是某种定向能武器攻击的结果，且是否存在掩盖真相的行为仍存争议。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了关于国家安全、潜在秘密武器攻击以及政府透明度的持续关注与调查。

items.title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
items.summary: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.
items.titleZh: 阿联酋称迪拜航空袭击者在澳大利亚开始“走向极端主义和恐怖主义”
items.summaryZh: 阿联酋总检察长指控该副驾驶员曾试图将飞机撞向特拉维夫机场。调查显示其激进化过程始于澳大利亚。
items.whyImportant: 此案凸显了航空安全面临的内部威胁以及跨国反恐合作的重要性。

items.title: Israel’s economy prospers despite years of war, but prices worry voters
items.summary: Tech is driving the economy, and investments are flowing in. But food costs are rising and debt is growing.
items.titleZh: 以色列经济在多年战争中保持繁荣，但物价令选民担忧
items.summaryZh: 尽管科技行业推动了经济增长并吸引了大量投资，但食品成本的上涨和债务的增加给民众生活带来了压力。
items.whyImportant: 经济增长与生活成本之间的矛盾已成为影响以色列国内政治与选民情绪的关键因素。

items.title: Create new pre-apprenticeship scheme to close youth unemployment gap, says Milburn
items.summary: Exclusive: Former minister’s review warns that dramatic action is needed over huge drop in youth apprenticeship starts A national apprenticeship readiness scheme should be introduced in England to close the gap for young people between leaving school and starting work, the government is to be told. Alan Milburn, who is leading a major review into Britain’s youth jobs crisis, will call for a new “national pre-apprenticeship route” to offer young people further education, training and work experience. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 米尔本建议建立新的学徒前培训计划以缩小青年失业差距
items.summaryZh: 英国政府被建议引入一项全国性的学徒准备计划，旨在帮助年轻人弥合离校与就业之间的鸿沟。该提议旨在应对英国日益严峻的青年就业危机。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过政策干预解决青年失业问题，对英国未来的劳动力市场结构具有重要意义。

items.title: Could Indonesia’s ‘content governor’ rival Prabowo for the presidency in 2029?
items.summary: Dressed in his trademark white shirt and traditional Sundanese headcloth, West Java Governor Dedi Mulyadi stood near the barren slopes of Mount Wayang. Announcing a new initiative to pay hundreds of local farmers to replant its forests and shield the region from flooding, he delivered a line perfectly pitched for the cameras tracking his every step. “I am a leader who does not want obedience caused by poverty,” he declared on September 26. “I want obedience caused by prosperity.” It is this...
items.titleZh: 印尼“网红省长”能否在2029年总统大选中挑战普拉博沃？
items.summaryZh: 西爪哇省省长德迪·穆利亚迪凭借其亲民形象和在环保及民生领域的积极举措，在社交媒体上获得了广泛关注。外界猜测他可能成为未来总统大选的有力竞争者。
items.whyImportant: 该人物的崛起反映了社交媒体在印尼政治中日益增长的影响力及其对未来权力格局的潜在改变。

items.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
items.summary: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.
items.titleZh: 巴拿马发生7.7级强震，建筑物受损
items.summaryZh: 巴拿马遭遇强震袭击，导致建筑物受损。周边国家已发布海啸预警，社交媒体上流传着灾区破坏的视频。
items.whyImportant: 强震对当地基础设施造成了严重破坏，并引发了区域性的海啸风险担忧。

items.title: Panama rocked by 2 powerful earthquakes, multiple aftershocks
items.summary: Two powerful 7.7 and 6.6 magnitude earthquakes and a series of aftershocks struck Panama on Friday afternoon, collapsing buildings near the epicentre and prompting evacuations across the country, the US Geological Survey said. The earlier quake, felt as far away as neighbouring Colombia, was centred about 10km (six miles) southwest of the remote community of Pitaloza Arriba, in the central province of Herrera, the USGS said. It struck at a depth of 10km. The USGS initially reported the first...
items.titleZh: 巴拿马遭遇两次强震及多次余震袭击
items.summaryZh: 巴拿马周五下午发生7.7级和6.6级地震，震中位于埃雷拉省。地震导致震中附近建筑物倒塌，全国范围内进行了紧急疏散。
items.whyImportant: 连续强震对巴拿马造成了广泛的破坏，救援与灾后评估工作正在紧急进行中。

items.title: Putin tells Trump peace talks are unlikely, cites Ukraine drone attacks
items.summary: Drone attacks on Moscow during last month's election undermined trilateral peace negotiations, the Kremlin says.
items.titleZh: 普京告诉特朗普和平谈判不太可能，并提及乌克兰的无人机袭击
items.summaryZh: 克里姆林宫表示，上个月大选期间针对莫斯科的无人机袭击破坏了三方和平谈判的基础。普京认为目前进行和平对话的时机并不成熟。
items.whyImportant: 此表态显示俄乌冲突的复杂性以及通过外交途径解决问题的难度依然巨大。

items.title: India’s capital locked down as youth protest targets election chief
items.summary: Police in the Indian capital detained scores of protesters on Saturday amid patrols by thousands of security forces, with travel and telecoms links suspended, in a lockdown to stop a youth protest asking the election chief to quit. The protest, called ‌by the “cockroach” youth movement, hopes to draw thousands of demonstrators who want Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to quit over a revision of voter lists that critics say favours Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Bharatiya Janata...
items.titleZh: 印度首都实施封锁，青年抗议活动针对选举官员
items.summaryZh: 印度首都新德里实施封锁，警方拘留了大量抗议者，并暂停了交通和电信服务。此次抗议由“蟑螂”青年运动发起，旨在要求首席选举专员辞职，抗议者认为选民名单的修订偏袒执政党。
items.whyImportant: 此次抗议反映了印度国内对选举公正性的担忧以及政府对异见声音的强硬管控。

items.title: Taiwan president says defence spending boost aims to ‘deter war’
items.summary: President Lai Ching-te emphasises peace and freedom, vows not to tolerate aggression in Taiwan Strait.
items.titleZh: 台湾地区领导人称增加国防开支旨在“遏制战争”
items.summaryZh: 赖清德强调和平与自由，并誓言不会容忍台湾海峡的侵略行为。他表示，提升国防预算的主要目的是为了增强威慑力，防止战争发生。
items.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了台海局势下，台湾地区在军事防御策略上的持续投入与立场。

items.title: Spirit of Hong Kong Awards: explorer inspires youth through glacial field trips
items.summary: When Wilson Cheung took Hong Kong secondary school students into the Swiss Alps this summer, terrain he had once been able to reach had become inaccessible. Glacier melt and thawing ground had destabilised parts of the mountain, while rockfall made fieldwork more hazardous. Only weeks earlier, Cheung had completed a roughly 1,700km (1,056-mile) scientific snowkite traverse across Greenland in 2026. The journey took him across the ice sheet while he continued collecting data in one of the world’s...
items.titleZh: 香港精神奖：探险家通过冰川实地考察激励青年
items.summaryZh: 探险家张伟贤带领香港中学生前往瑞士阿尔卑斯山考察，亲眼见证了气候变化导致的冰川融化和地形不稳。他此前还完成了格陵兰岛的科学考察，旨在通过实地探索提升青年的环保意识。
items.whyImportant: 该报道通过探险家的经历展示了气候变化对地理环境的直接影响，并强调了科学教育的重要性。

items.title: Why a Communist Party boss had a coffee shop date with Chinese content creators
items.summary: The setting may have been casual but the choice was not when the Communist Party boss of a northeastern Chinese province sat down with digital content creators at a coffee shop on Wednesday. Jilin province party secretary Huang Qiang invited the influencers to the relaxed setting of the Songyuan Coffee Shop in Changchun to encourage them to “actively promote mainstream values and spread positive energy”. According to a local government statement, Huang and the participants also exchanged views...
items.titleZh: 为何一位省委书记与中国内容创作者在咖啡馆约谈
items.summaryZh: 吉林省委书记黄强在长春一家咖啡馆与数字内容创作者座谈。他鼓励创作者积极宣传主流价值观并传播正能量，双方就相关议题交换了意见。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了地方政府试图通过非正式渠道加强对网络舆论和内容创作者的引导。

items.title: Lack of heat action plan leaves Hong Kong’s vulnerable residents at risk, experts warn
items.summary: Environmentalists and academics have criticised the omission of a systemic heat-health action plan in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and latest policy address, warning that relying on “common sense” is failing to protect vulnerable residents from rising temperatures. Their comments came as new research from the University of Hong Kong (HKU) found that extreme heat may have contributed to as many as 3,238 excess deaths in the city over the past decade. In response to the South China Morning...
items.titleZh: 专家警告：缺乏高温行动计划使香港弱势群体面临风险
items.summaryZh: 环保人士和学者批评香港的五年计划及政策报告中缺乏系统性的高温健康行动计划。研究显示，过去十年极端高温可能导致香港超过3000人超额死亡。
items.whyImportant: 该警告促使社会关注气候变化背景下，城市公共卫生政策对弱势群体保护的缺失。

items.title: Thousands of security personnel deployed as Delhi braces for ‘cockroach’ protest
items.summary: Several trains to Delhi have been cancelled and dozens of metro stations are shut to stop protesters from gathering.
items.titleZh: 德里部署数千名安保人员以应对“蟑螂”抗议活动
items.summaryZh: 为阻止抗议者聚集，德里已取消多趟列车并关闭了数十个地铁站。当局部署了大量安保力量以维持城市秩序。
items.whyImportant: 大规模的安保措施反映了印度首都当前紧张的社会局势及政府对潜在动荡的严密防范。

items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
items.summary: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".
items.titleZh: 特朗普宣布达成俄罗斯柴油协议，泽连斯基称其为给普京的礼物
items.summaryZh: 特朗普宣布了一项进口俄罗斯柴油的协议，引发乌克兰总统泽连斯基的强烈批评。泽连斯基称此举是对战争的投资，必须予以制止。
items.whyImportant: 此协议在国际地缘政治中引发争议，被视为可能削弱对俄制裁效果并加剧美乌外交摩擦。

items.title: Israeli drone attack wounds six in Lebanon near Syria border
items.summary: Five Syrians and one Lebanese wounded in latest Israeli attack, Lebanon's health authorities say.
items.titleZh: 以色列无人机袭击黎巴嫩叙利亚边境附近，造成六人受伤
items.summaryZh: 据黎巴嫩卫生部门消息，以色列的最新袭击造成五名叙利亚人和一名黎巴嫩人受伤。袭击发生在黎巴嫩与叙利亚边境附近。
items.whyImportant: 此次袭击加剧了该地区的紧张局势，增加了边境冲突进一步扩大的风险。
